name: Data.triangleOrder_eq_mul_levelIndex
summary: Count invertible matrices through the surjective reduction from O_E/𝔟Q to O_E/MQ: the index of the level is a mean over the residue ring of 𝔟Q, and the reduction multiplies counts by a fixed power.

steps.claim: Take C = (|O_E/MQ (untwisted)| / |O_E/𝔟 (untwisted)|)^{|Y_j|²}. For every ϑ: the index of the level is the number of invertible |Y_j| × |Y_j| matrices over O_E/𝔟Q divided by … (finite means, `finMean`), the mean of the indicator of the units is unchanged when composed with the surjective reduction to O_E/MQ (`finMean_comp_surjective`, invertibility read on the determinant, the reduction being local), and the sizes of the residue rings factor over the places (`card_𝔪`).
steps.lean:
C * levelIndex ϑ false 0 j := ⟨(card (D.triangleModulus false 1).ResRing / card
  (D.gridModulus 1).ResRing) ^ card (D.Y j) ^ 2, fun ϑ ↦ by
  simpa [finMean, nodeLevel, levelIndex, card_congr of.symm, card_𝔪, mul_pow, div_pow, field, sq,
    pow_mul, prod_eq_zero_iff, (card_congr (.ofInjective _ Units.val_injective)).trans (card_subtype
    IsUnit), isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, ← RingHom.map_det, -RingHom.mapMatrix_apply] using!
    (finMean_comp_surjective
    ((reduceToTriangle ϑ false).mapMatrix (m := D.Y j)).toAddMonoidHom (factor_surjective _ :
    Surjective (reduceToTriangle ..)).comp_left.comp_left (if IsUnit · then 1 else 0)).symm⟩
